action: six separate pixel art monsters in a 3 by 2 grid, each in its own cell and facing left. All six attack at the same time, each staying inside its own cell: the zombie farmer jabs the pitchfork forward to the left, the wolf snaps its jaws and lunges its head to the left, the scarecrow swings its straw arms forward, the hooded bandit stabs the dagger to the left, the crow flaps its wings and pecks to the left, the skeleton swings its sword down to the left. Then each returns to its starting pose. Bodies stay in place, same size, same colours.
